verdict.rationale: Resend has a public pricing page. It names Pro and Scale plans, describes a self-serve add-on ('This adds 100 more… add or remove it yourself'), and describes a managed dedicated IP that Resend warms up and autoscales, so some plan and add-on information is visible without a sales call. However, the pack shows no actual prices, per-volume tier thresholds, overage rates, or validation costs. missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, dedicated IP price, email validation add-on pricing, independent confirmation that a founder can price usage fully from the site.

support.subject: As a founder, I can price the service from the public site alone — per-volume tiers, overage rates, and add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) published without a sales call

citations.quote: This adds 100 more on top of it. Available on Pro and Scale, and you can add or remove it yourself whenever you need to.
We will warmup, monitor, and autoscale it based on your utilization so you can focus on one thing, sending.
Their very cheap pay as you go pricing is more attractive than Resend's monthly pricing.
